raw:
@q query
  mode count
  select ?p
  rank highest ?c
  where all
    match
      relation "close"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?t
      role object "the L2 queue"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "close"
      role subject ?p
      role object ?t
      role time ?time
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  during "last week"
